# 1 - Data Import and Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(psych)
```

```{r}
# Import the dataset
df <- read_delim("~/SchoolWork/Y2S1/IO/PS1/IRI.csv")

glimpse(df)
describe(df$brand)
describe(df$parent)
```

# 2 - Descriptive Statistics by Brand
```{r}
df_market <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cereal_vars = c(
      price,
      brand_num = n_distinct(brand),
      parent_num = n_distinct(parent),
      flavored,
      fortified,
      fiber,
      sugars,
      sold = (price*quantity)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(week_id, store_id) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(cereal_vars), 
      list(
      mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      var = ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))
  
```
